text:
I don’t understand how a clinic can call itself psychiatric when it’s supposed to support the mental health of its patients.

My appointment was scheduled for 7:20 PM.
I arrived on time and was told to wait 30 minutes.
I ended up waiting until 8:40 PM, after which I was asked to wait another 30 minutes.

Unfortunately, I already had very important plans at 9 PM, so I had to leave.

On top of that, every Thai patient was allowed to go ahead of me while I was kept waiting and placed last.
